messages:
sasha: heads up — noticed pages didn't reach oncall for the 21:12 deploy window. customer impact reports coming in. :rotating_light:

mike: seen. did pagerflow show any outbound deliveries?

sasha: webhook queue spiked, then paused. our alerting listed "pagerflow-outbound: suppressed: 503 downstream" around the same time.

devops-bot: alert: pagerflow-outbound queue length > 500 (5m avg). rate limiter engaged.

anya: I'm oncall now, will try to trigger a manual page and see if it goes through.

anya: /pager page test oncall — nothing. no ring.

stu: checking pagerflow logs. seeing 502 responses from notify-gateway, then a flood of 429s from pager vendor.

mike: did the incident-bot fall back to slack-channel-only? incident-bot says it should fallback to SMS after 3 failed attempts.

incident-bot: automated note — fallback attempt 1: slack-only; fallback attempt 2: sms attempted; sms failed (vendor 429); fallback attempt 3: manual escalation required.

lia: we have partial customer reports — a subset of sessions unable to start inference, ~8% of requests failing 503. tagging support.

sasha: can someone try restarting pagerflow-outbound? quick restart and drain might re-enable outbound workers.

mike: I'm hesitant to restart without understanding auth. last time restart needed key rotation too.

anya: I can take the restart. I'll run a graceful drain: set scale to 0 then back to 3.

support-triage-bot: customer-impact: multiple tenants reporting request timeouts and default fallback to queued state. Escalation level: P2 until paging restored.

anya: running: kubectl -n infra scale deployment/pagerflow-outbound --replicas=0  (will wait 20s)

mike: copying the quick test to validate webhooks:
```bash
curl -X POST https://pagerflow.prod.internal/webhook/test -H 'X-Redwood-Signature: test' -d '{"event":"ping"}' -v
```

stu: logs show connect timeout to notify-gateway at 21:11:13, then a certificate validation error intermittently. could be a network egress issue to vendor.

mike: lia — can you confirm if external vendor is showing degraded region? ping them.

lia: already on it, opened vendor ticket INC-98321. vendor status shows "degraded — high latency" in eu-west.

sasha: if vendor is degraded, our automation should have already routed to sms fallback provider. incident-bot says sms attempts failed due to 429. maybe our secondary provider also rate-limited.

mike: true — we have two providers. both show 429 responses in recent logs. looks like global vendor incident.

anya: manual paging plan: 1) notify SRE-mobile to open direct escalation number 2) post a short incident summary to #customers-notify 3) continue trying requeue with exponential backoff.

mike: I can post to #customers-notify with suggested copy. Sasha, can you sanity-check the message?

sasha: yes. Draft: "We are investigating a third-party paging outage affecting incident notifications. If you are an enterprise customer and not receiving alerts, please contact support@redwood-inference.com. We're working on alternatives and will share updates every 15 minutes."

support-triage-bot: reaction :thumbsup: from 3 users.

devops-bot: pagerflow-outbound scaled back up to 3 replicas. healthchecks passing.

anya: after restart, manual test page: /pager page test oncall -> SUCCESS, SMS delivered.

incident-bot: note — automated paging resumed at 21:18:22. fallback queue drained.

lia: vendor updated — partial recovery in eu-west. their throttling windows are lifting slowly.

stu: we still have to check if any missed pages during the 6 minute window need manual escalation.

mike: action items: 1) run audit of all pages between 21:10-21:18 2) confirm any missed P2s and notify customers 3) add temporary runbook step: if vendor returns 429 repeatedly, auto-escalate to manual phone ring through SRE-mobile.

sasha: I'll take #1 and #2. starting audit now.

sasha: audit done — 12 unique alerts attempted, 4 failed to deliver to SMS but posted to incident channel. three of those were customer-impacting. Reach out to affected customers and offer mitigations.

mike: noted. PR for runbook change coming. also let's add more aggressive health-checking between pagerflow and vendor next week.

anya: thanks all. I'll stay on for the next 30 minutes to monitor. please ping me if paging fails again. :white_check_mark:
